Second slug 'plastech-international-pvt-ltd' returned the same shell with 'Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records of companies all over the world.' Rows actually seen: 0 of 0. No export record found, but absence is not established because the sources were inaccessible, not empty.

note: Evidence could not be gathered: all four trade-data providers were blocked (403 / JS challenge) and both search backends were down, so this is a tooling failure, not a negative finding. Do NOT read 'unknown' as 'no shipments' and do not treat the ImportKey boilerplate as a shipment record — it is a generic page template that appears for any slug, including non-existent ones. The declared HS codes 950300/950490 (toys, video game consoles) are inconsistent with the claimed industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food and FMCG); per project rule 3 this is not grounds for rejection — the company stays in the base and the code should be corrected to the actual one once a real shipment record is obtained. The brand 'Buddzy' and the legal name 'PLASTECH INTERNATIONAL PRIVATE LIMITED' were not independently linked by any source I could open. Revenue and export volume: null — not public in anything retrieved, not estimated. Recommended next step: re-run with a working search backend, or pull the record from a paid Volza/Eximpedia view, and check GST turnover on the GST portal plus GeM/CPPP for tender participation.
